# interview-practice-coach

Asks interview questions for a role you name, one at a time, scores each answer with feedback, and ends on a recap of what to fix.

A practice interview you hold as a conversation. It asks one question at a time for the role you name, then coaches on your answer: what worked, what was missing, a rewrite of your opening line, and a 1-5 score on content, structure, evidence, fit and conciseness. Ask for a model answer, a harder round or a different topic at any point. At the end it gives a recap of the three things to fix.
